recap: Nifty 50 ended at 25,227.95 (-0.63%) and the Sensex at 82,031.81 (-0.61%); Bank Nifty moved -0.38%.
By size: large caps (Nifty 100) -0.76%, mid caps (Midcap 150) -1.14%, small caps (Smallcap 250) -0.49%.
FIIs were net buyers of ₹5,867 cr and DIIs net sellers of ₹3,160 cr (provisional, NSE).
PSU Bank led the sectors (+0.59%), while Metal lagged (-2.46%).
Top Nifty 500 gainer was INOX India (+7.81%); biggest faller was Caplin Point (-7.20%). Breadth: 122 advances vs 376 declines.
Overseas, the S&P 500 last closed down 0.48% and the Nasdaq down 0.21%.
The rupee is at 93.43 per dollar, Brent at $89.62 (-3.78%) and gold at $3,769 (-2.46%).
